mapper.select: select * from favorite where uid = #{uid} and is_delete = 0
SELECT fv.vid, fv.time FROM favorite_video fv WHERE fv.fid = #{fid} AND fv.is_remove = 0 ORDER BY fv.time DESC
SELECT f.fid FROM favorite_video fv JOIN favorite f ON fv.fid = f.fid WHERE fv.vid = #{vid} AND f.uid = #{uid} AND fv.is_remove = 0 AND f.is_delete = 0
